acceptanceCriteria: A paged listing of supplied status claims filtered by state, optional qualifier and (for migration mappings) run returns subject IDs and anchors.
docs_intent without id lists the corpus's intent comparisons, paged.
Focused tests cover both; the PR body says Closes #1556.
body: GitHub issue beamfall/corvint#1556 (1.0.0-rc.3, main 6e90476). A migration ledger imports (DCP-V1-306/307: 3,516 inventory units, 1,872 migration_mapping relations, 1,862 status claims), but only docs_coverage counts or per-unit docs_get answer 'which units in run R are in state S'. docs_intent requires an id, so listing intent comparisons returns no-match. Builds on V1-2334 (GH #1491).
title: GH #1556: no listing of supplied status claims by state, qualifier or run, and docs_intent cannot list intent comparisons
